reviewType: Existing R07.2 release evidence reconciliation; no new runtime build in this review commit

downloadedArtifact.countingNote: Repeated product/parameter checks; not an independent-physical-capability count. Reports were read and hashes recomputed; their browser runs were executed by the named workflow.

reviewObservations: Inspected public artifact wallet whole, seam macro, lifted-wallet and western-hat views. These are QA evidence, not image substitutes for the interactive deliverable.
Continuous flattened yarn and actual apertures are present; local R05 surface-response comparison and real pointer grip/release are included in the public report.

A separate CPU wallet diagnostic at rest and after a 160-nominal-step swing found no negative clearance among 382 selected outward yarn sample vertices against their corresponding front-panel triangles. This is not a proof of all-layer or all-product non-intersection.

The review-session file URL browser attempt was blocked by its environment policy. It is not counted as an additional successful browser run; the successful standalone/public evidence is from workflow 38019186995.
remainingLimits: Visual acceptance remains PENDING_USER, not a top-tier-quality certification.
Particle contacts do not establish continuous triangle or hardware collision safety; rapid folding and inter-layer overlap still need broader testing.
The R05 local contact field is not complete thread friction or tension propagation.
Thickness scaling is computational, not real-leather material calibration; craft padding and patina are authored approximations.
Only prototype pattern output; hat and bag manufacturing patterns are not validated.
Mobile evidence is a 390x844 viewport simulation, not phone hardware.
